warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Build Momentum in close combat, then break enemy lines.

basic.name: Slash
basic.description: Strike an adjacent enemy and build Momentum.

special.name: Cleave
special.description: Sweep the three spaces ahead of you.

defensive.name: Parry
defensive.description: Arm a reaction that reduces the next incoming hit.

movement.name: Charge
movement.description: Rush in a straight line and crash into the first obstacle.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: Build Focus at range and shape the battlefield with arcane force.

basic.name: Arcane Missile
basic.description: Strike a visible enemy at range and build Focus from distant hits.

special.name: Arcane Cannon
special.description: Fire arcane power through every target in a straight line.

defensive.name: Repel
defensive.description: Arm a reaction that pushes away the next attacker.

movement.name: Blink
movement.description: Teleport to an open space within three tiles.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: Bind enemies, preserve recent wounds, and turn Grace into power.

basic.name: Binding Light
basic.description: Damage and slow a target with binding light.

special.name: Empower
special.description: Empower your next attack with stronger effects.

defensive.name: Recover
defensive.description: Arm a reaction that restores half the health lost to the next hit.

movement.name: Dash
movement.description: Move up to three tiles and heal when traveling at least two.

tank.name: Tank
tank.description: Gain Resolve by absorbing pressure and punish clustered attackers.

basic.name: Shield Bash
basic.description: Strike and push an adjacent enemy.

special.name: Retribution
special.description: Store part of incoming damage and release it next turn.

defensive.name: Guard
defensive.description: Arm a reaction that heavily reduces the next incoming hit.

movement.name: Leap
movement.description: Leap within three tiles, damaging and taunting nearby enemies.

phantom.name: Phantom
phantom.description: Create Edge through unfair angles, then execute isolated prey.

basic.name: Pierce
basic.description: Pierce a target and strike an enemy directly behind it.

special.name: Assassinate
special.description: Deliver a powerful strike against an isolated target.

defensive.name: Evade
defensive.description: Arm a reaction that slips away from the next attacker.

movement.name: Shadowstep
movement.description: Move two or three spaces and emerge Hidden.

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.description: Fight as one with a bonded wolf using commands, Cover, and Mount.

basic.name: Mark / Command
basic.description: Mark a target and command your bonded wolf to attack.

special.name: Summon
special.description: Summon your wolf or command it to pounce on a marked target.

defensive.name: Cover
defensive.description: Arm a reaction that shares the next hit with your wolf.

movement.name: Mount
movement.description: Ride your wolf to an open space within five tiles.
